user: Dev restarts on Windows now avoid silent command mangling — fewer false "the fix doesn't work" loops caused by broken kill/relaunch commands
what: Documented a Windows-shell gotcha hit while restarting the dev app: Git Bash (MSYS) rewrites flags like `/f` into paths (`F:/`), so kill/relaunch commands silently break; fix is MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 or PowerShell, and always kill by specific PID.
why: The restart chain is the standard way to rule out stale webviews; when its commands silently mangle, debugging wastes a full loop chasing a bug that no longer exists.
next: See docs/wiki/learnings/msys-path-conversion-mangles-f-style-windows-flags-use-msys-.md before running taskkill/start from bash
summary: Recorded a learning from the /data tab URL-sync debugging session: MSYS path conversion silently rewrites `/f`-style Windows flags into drive paths (use `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` or PowerShell), plus the practice of killing app/vite by specific PID instead of blanket `taskkill /IM node.exe /f`.

user: The app no longer freezes after certain failed queries — the database connection now self-recovers in about a second instead of needing an app restart

why: A wedged connection used to mean a silently frozen app and a manual restart, throwing away whatever the user was doing.

what: Documented the SQL-guard trust-boundary fix in the query compiler as a learning: unknown dimension columns must fail validation; only expression dims explicitly marked raw bypass it.

summary: Recorded the one durable finding from the fix-all-errors session not already in the wiki: compile.ts's dimension schema guard blanket-caught all checkColumn failures (because resolved master-item expression dims are indistinguishable from plain column picks), letting unknown columns interpolate raw. Fix documented: resolveItems marks expression dims raw:true — the only sanctioned validation bypass; everything else must pass schema validation. The session's other findings (heap corruption from dynamic json extension, initialize_duckdb no-op on workspace switch, workspace portability decisions, workspace.rs entity page, and the user-facing fix changelog entry) were already recorded earlier today and were verified, not duplicated.
